snippet.description:

La bienvenida incluyó honores de Estado, un pasillo de cadetes y el saludo de las autoridades presentes.

Durante su estadía en Uruguay, prevista hasta el 8 de noviembre, León XIV mantendrá un encuentro con el presidente, encabezará una ceremonia en la Plaza Independencia, visitará el barrio Casavalle, participará en una vigilia en el Estadio Centenario y oficiará misas multitudinarias en Paysandú y Florida.

La llegada del Pontífice despertó una enorme expectativa entre los fieles, mientras las campanas de las iglesias uruguayas sonaban para celebrar su visita. snippet.title: 7 Unwritten Rules of ARC Raiders #gaming #gamingvideos #gamingshorts #arcraiders #fortnite #ps5
snippet.description:
There are 7 unwritten rules of ARC Raiders, and some of you rats REALLY need to start following them.

ARC Raiders is an extraction shooter where every encounter with another Raider can turn into a firefight, an unexpected friendship, or a complete disaster.

But just because you CAN shoot another player doesn't mean you SHOULD.

After countless raids, the ARC Raiders community has developed its own unofficial code of conduct. From respecting locked key rooms and sharing ARC loot to reviving downed players and protecting flute musicians, these are the 7 unwritten rules of ARC Raiders etiquette that every player should know.

And if you're breaking these rules? You're a rat, and you might get shot.

1. Respect Open Key Rooms

If you find an unlocked key room and another Raider is already inside, assume they used their own key to open it.

Don't enter and steal their loot.

Wait until they've finished looting and left before going inside.

They spent the key. They get first dibs.

2. Flashlight Means Friendly

Not every friendly Raider uses proximity voice chat.

If someone flashes their flashlight at you, they're signaling that they're friendly, even if they're not speaking.

Respect the flashlight signal.

Let them pass peacefully, and they'll hopefully do the same for you.

Of course, trust is never guaranteed in ARC Raiders.

3. Always Bring a Defib

A defibrillator can turn a terrible raid into an unforgettable moment of cooperation.

Always carry a defib when possible.

And if another Raider revives you, offer them something in return as a thank-you.

They don't have to accept your gift, but showing appreciation is part of being a decent Raider.

4. Respect Large ARC Kills

If another player takes down a massive ARC enemy by themselves, they deserve first access to the loot.

We're talking about:

Bombardiers

Bastions

Bullies

Rocketeers

Don't rush in and steal ARC components from someone else's kill.

Wait until they've finished looting or walked away entirely.

Nobody likes a loot thief.

5. NEVER Kill the Musicians

This one should be obvious.

Don't kill the flute players.

If someone is wandering through the Rust Belt playing music, let them enjoy their moment.

Not every Raider encounter needs to end in violence.

Respect the musicians.

6. Wait for Other Raiders at Extraction

If you're extracting and another Raider is running toward the elevator, give them a chance to make it.

Wait at least 10 seconds when it's safe to do so.

Sometimes those extra seconds are the difference between a successful extraction and losing an entire inventory.

A little kindness goes a long way.

7. Stella Montis Is for PvP

Let's be clear about one thing.

Stella Montis is PvP territory.

If you're heading into Stella Montis, expect other Raiders to shoot first and ask questions later.

Getting killed is part of the experience.

Don't act surprised when the most aggressive players in ARC Raiders are looking for a fight.

The Unofficial ARC Raiders Code of Conduct

These aren't official Embark Studios rules. They're community etiquette, and not everyone will agree with them.

But the best part of ARC Raiders isn't always the loot, rare blueprints, legendary weapons, or PvP kills.

It's the unpredictable interactions between strangers.

The Raider who revives you when they could have finished you off. The stranger who shares their loot. The player who waits for you at extraction.

You don't have to be friendly to everyone, but you don't have to be a rat either.

What Rules Did I Miss?

Do you agree with these seven unwritten rules?

Should key rooms belong to whoever opened them? Is flashing your flashlight a universal peace signal? Should musicians always be protected?

And is Stella Montis really the unofficial PvP map?

snippet.title: Piamonte, tierra de placeres: entre los Alpes, las trufas y la dolce vita | DW Documental
snippet.description:
Pueblos de ensueño, excelentes vinos y una capital rebosante de historia. Desde los Alpes hasta el lago Maggiore, el Piamonte, en el noroeste de Italia, combina diversidad paisajística con gran tradición gastronómica.

Los Alpes, con más de 4600 metros de altura, al oeste; el lago Maggiore al norte; suaves colinas al sur; la llanura del Po al este; y, en medio de todo ello, Turín, la famosa ciudad italiana de la cultura y el automovilismo. Ya sean trufas, arroz, avellanas, vino o el famoso "vitello tonnato”, el Piamonte también tiene mucho que ofrecer en el ámbito culinario.

Como muchas regiones montañosas de Europa, numerosos valles alpinos sufrieron durante décadas la despoblación. Sin embargo, la vida pausada y en contacto con la naturaleza vuelve a atraer a nuevas generaciones. Gracias a un programa de fomento público, cada vez más familias jóvenes regresan a pueblos abandonados y traen nuevas ideas.
Es el caso de Silvia Rovere, la alcaldesa que trabaja para revitalizar Ostana, o de Roberto Miretti, que cambió el volante de su camión por un telar. En el lago Maggiore, un grupo de submarinistas lucha por preservar la biodiversidad de sus aguas. En la vasta llanura del Po, Tiziana Monterisi está transformando de manera sostenible el mundo de la arquitectura mediante residuos de la cosecha del arroz. Y en el Parque Nacional del Gran Paradiso, a más de 2.500 metros de altitud, la guardaparques Raffaella Miravalle dedica sus esfuerzos a la protección del ecosistema alpino.
Cerca de Alba, un trifulau, nombre con el que se conoce a los famosos buscadores de trufas del Piamonte, recorre los bosques en busca de este preciado tesoro. Vende sus trufas a una familia que lleva décadas dedicada al comercio de este hongo y los transforma en todo tipo de delicias.

snippet.title: Pourquoi c'est horrible d'avoir les cheveux bouclés ? 🌧️
snippet.description:
Manon naît avec plus de cheveux que son père… et Mamie regarde ses boucles gonfler : « Il va pleuvoir. » Ensuite : le crayon perdu dans les boucles (retrouvé trois jours plus tard, avec une gomme et une petite voiture), la maîtresse qui regarde ses cheveux au lieu de la météo, le cheveu sur le savon pris pour une araignée, la coupe en triangle, le jour de lavage sous la serviette, la montre de l'amoureux coincée 😅 Et Mamie avait raison depuis le début…

Et toi, tu as une copine aux cheveux bouclés ? Identifie-la en commentaire 👇

Sources :
• Le cheveu bouclé pousse déjà courbé sous la peau : son bulbe a la forme d'une crosse de golf (Thibaut et al., British Journal of Dermatology, 2005)
• Les boucles sont génétiques à 85-95 % d'après une étude de jumeaux (Medland, Zhu & Martin, Twin Research and Human Genetics, 2009)
• En 1783, Horace-Bénédict de Saussure mesurait l'humidité de l'air avec un cheveu humain : l'hygromètre à cheveu (Essais sur l'hygrométrie, 1783)

#cheveuxboucles #boucles #shorts
